tools.name: talon_health
tools.description: Check Talon and upstream status (DexScreener, Robinhood RPC, GoPlus, live trades, RHJ stocks) before a research run.

tools.name: talon_detect
tools.description: Detect newly seen Robinhood Chain tokens with market stats and confluence scores. Use this to hunt early memes/alts.

tools.name: talon_alpha
tools.description: Rank tokens where sentiment, fundamentals, and price action align. Returns the best asymmetric candidates, not trade orders.

tools.name: talon_breakout
tools.description: Feed of $200k–$1m (core) or just-graduated $20k–$200k (early) tokens scored for $10m. Early is the 1% hunt: 99% of grads die before $200k. Uses volume/cap, FOMO cluster, whale hits, stock-route pairing, live LP. Research candidates, not orders.

tools.name: talon_graduate
tools.description: Just-graduated Pons coins under $200k. Read `calls` for conviction (high / medium / low). Suggested slice of supply is a hint — size and exits are yours. Does not sign.

tools.name: talon_desk
tools.description: High-conviction book. New pools first (minutes old, live LP, no twitter name required), then a named first hold on this contract. Qualify on the fill, not the live cap — stays up for six hours even after it runs. Famous desks still count when that fill is under $400k. Coins sitting $25k–$200k for 12

tools.name: talon_open
tools.description: New pools on this chain: minutes old, live LP, still under $400k. No named FOMO handle required. This is the window before remus prints. Off-chain printers live on talon_wire. No fill size. No exit. Does not sign.

tools.name: talon_wire
tools.description: Printers on other chains (BSC, Solana, Base). Hunt matches the six-hour keep. Copies of the same ticker are not the print — the mint with the LP is. Ember on Solana and Vape Cat on BSC are this book. Hands does not buy these. If the same name opens on Robinhood, talon_open fires. No fill size. No ex

tools.name: talon_stall
tools.description: Coins sitting $25k–$200k for 12 hours or more with live LP. This is the BONER/MEME sit. Stays on the book until they leave the band. No fill size. No exit. Does not sign.

tools.name: talon_eval
tools.description: Did Talon catch every coin that went under $25k to $500k+, every $100k–$200k sit that later printed millions, and off-chain printers like Vape Cat on BSC and Ember on Solana? Locked fixtures fail the build if a printer is missed. Last-3-days is the live FOMO book through the same flag.

tools.name: talon_cohort
tools.description: Nansen for this chain. Wallets that bought a 7-figure name under $200k. smart vs sniper. clustered is two or more smart wallets on a new name still under $200k. Snipers do not fire the desk. Not a fill size. Not an exit. Talon does not sign.

tools.name: talon_winners
tools.description: Last-month FOMO printers and live analogs: CASHCAT, MEME/AMC, BONER, CINEMA, plus Solana ZCAT/FLORK signatures. What printed from sub-$1m to tens of millions, and what the model learned.

tools.name: talon_calls
tools.description: Model ledger: open $10m calls, 7d/30d settlements, hit/miss, current Hedge weights. This is how the algorithm checks itself.

tools.name: talon_bot
tools.description: Autonomous trader for Hands. Returns the live target book. Read `calls` / `say` for conviction. Size and exits are yours — Talon recommends, it does not fill. POST holdings for a diff. GET is the book only. Poll every 5–15 min. Talon does not sign. Honor avoid. Not financial advice.

tools.name: talon_hands
tools.description: What Hermes Hands would buy this tick. New pools first, then named first holds, then sits. Size is yours. Does not sell. Does not sign. POST holdings to skip names you already have.

tools.name: talon_wallet
tools.description: Smart wallet operator: risk-sleeved auto-save (Kamino), ghost-bag radar for tokens you sold that later printed, cross-chain $10m trades (Robinhood / Solana / BSC / Base), off-crypto sleeve in official RHJ stocks. Talon never signs. POST sells so it can watch dumps. Not financial advice.

tools.name: talon_usac
tools.description: USAC, the one-token dollar. Mint, hold, get more USAC as the pot earns (live Kamino + optional trade sleeve). Redeem at NAV. POST action=mint with usd. Talon never signs. Not issued by the United States. Not financial advice.

tools.name: talon_scan
tools.description: Full token intel: market, rug check, bundle/sniper analysis, social signals, and confluence. Required before any thesis on a specific token.

tools.name: talon_rug
tools.description: Rug/honeypot/tax/ownership check for a Robinhood Chain token via GoPlus plus LP heuristics.

tools.name: talon_bundle
tools.description: Bundle/sniper analysis from on-chain Transfer logs plus DEX buy-pressure heuristics.

tools.name: talon_diligence
tools.description: On-chain funny business. Pons tax-exempt snipe cluster that hops into a larger warehouse then dumps, plus fake-activity boosts. Agent Chud diligence. Research, not an order.

tools.name: talon_signals
tools.description: Map social surfaces (X/Telegram/web), DexScreener boosts, paid profiles, and community takeovers to a token.

tools.name: talon_story
tools.description: Narrative for a new token: who bought, Dex-linked X, and live X search via TinyFish when TINYFISH_API_KEY is set. Fast. Desk/open/wire already stamp a cached story. Use this for a named ticker.

tools.name: talon_social
tools.description: Cross-token social graph: X handles linked from live Robinhood Chain token profiles, matched to on-chain activity.

tools.name: talon_search
tools.description: Search Robinhood Chain pairs by ticker, name, or narrative keyword.

tools.name: talon_traders
tools.description: FOMO-trader leaderboard: tracked wallets, hit rate, realized/unrealized P/L, volume, open bags. Sort by pnl, hit_rate, volume, fills, or realized.

tools.name: talon_trader
tools.description: One FOMO trader: hit rate, closed P/L, open bags, recent round-trips. Pass a fomo.family handle or a 0x wallet.

tools.name: talon_tape
tools.description: Live trades from tracked wallets. Newest buys and sells. first=true keeps only first-buys.

tools.name: talon_data
tools.description: Fast datasource for a UI or an agent. Same robinhoodtrenches.com live trades, 1s fresh. Board snapshot (status, trades, traders, tokens, closed, flow, radar) or a slice. Plug a table on /data anytime. Not a signed order.

tools.name: talon_hot
tools.description: What's hot: tokens tracked FOMO wallets are buying right now, ranked by clustered dollar flow. autobuy=true is a recommendation, not a fill size. Stocks and single-sniper prints stay off autobuy.

tools.name: talon_styles
tools.description: Live desk of whoever is actually printing on FOMO, not a fixed eight. Named handles (frankdegods, unipcs, rasmr) are aliases. Anyone with fills or closed trades gets a weight. Fan-in of live trades, DexScreener, Robinhood chain, and X socials. autobuy names are what the wallet copies. Not financial

tools.name: talon_rl
tools.description: PufferLib policy trained on settled trades of frankdegods and the live FOMO board. POST trains. GET scores live names. Copy when pCopy>=0.5. Research, not an order. Talon does not sign.

tools.name: talon_closed
tools.description: Closed round-trips for tracked FOMO traders: cost, proceeds, P/L, hold time, win/loss.

tools.name: talon_flow
tools.description: Copy-flow: a FOMO lead buy and the wallets that followed into the same token, with lag in seconds.

tools.name: talon_radar
tools.description: Fresh tokens FOMO wallets just touched. Use to catch first prints before they crowd.

tools.name: talon_playbook
tools.description: LP-season playbook: capture meme flow by providing concentrated liquidity on official stock/USDG pools instead of holding memes.

tools.name: talon_complexes
tools.description: Hottest tokenized-stock complexes on Robinhood Chain. routingVolume24h is volume on stock/USDG and stock/WETH — the hop meme trades take.

tools.name: talon_lp
tools.description: Rank official stock/USDG (or stock/WETH) LP pools. Prefer v3 (no hooks), TVL ≥ $100k, sort by volume/TVL. Do not LP the meme.

tools.name: talon_stock
tools.description: One official RHJ stock token: true bid/ask vs AMM premium, stock/USDG LP pools, meme legs, correlated/bridge pairs.

tools.name: talon_pool
tools.description: Inspect one stock/USDG or stock/WETH pool: TVL, volume/TVL, fee APR, range hint, hook risk, verdict.

tools.name: talon_premium
tools.description: AMM price vs official RHJ true bid/ask. If premium is high, acquire the stock via Rialto (propAMM), not the AMM.

tools.name: talon_join
tools.description: Agent self-serve signup. No human. Mints an API key (shown once). Send it as X-Talon-Key. Usage is counted. No seat fee. Call this the first time you land here.

tools.name: talon_answer
tools.description: Ask Talon in plain language. Returns a structured answer (hot, styles, wallet, $10m, handshake). Built for agents, not a UI.

tools.name: talon_monitor
tools.description: Long-running agents: set a webhook. Talon POSTs when clustered buys, copied desks, or a dumped bag prints. Poll /monitor to read the last event. No human dashboard.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "talon_story" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: talon_bot, talon_usac, talon_rl, talon_monitor · Private data: talon_detect, talon_alpha, talon_breakout, talon_wallet, talon_usac, talon_scan, talon_rug, talon_signals, talon_story, talon_social, talon_trader, talon_data, talon_hot, talon_styles, talon_flow, talon_radar, talon_stock, talon_join, talon_answer · Public sink: talon_bot, talon_hands, talon_wallet, talon_usac, talon_rl, talon_join, talon_monitor · Destructive: talon_health, talon_eval.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: talon_bot, talon_usac, talon_rl, talon_monitor · Private data: talon_detect, talon_alpha, talon_breakout, talon_wallet, talon_usac, talon_scan, talon_rug, talon_signals, talon_story, talon_social, talon_trader, talon_data, talon_hot, talon_styles, talon_flow, talon_radar, talon_stock, talon_join, talon_answer · Public sink: talon_bot, talon_hands, talon_wallet, talon_usac, talon_rl, talon_join, talon_monitor · Destructive: talon_health, talon_eval

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
